themes.title: Far-right push for 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across Europe are intensifying demands for 'national priority' policies, particularly in housing, social benefits, and employment. This theme is evident in Spain, Sweden, and Norway, where parties like Vox, Sverigedemokraterna, and Fremskrittspartiet are advocating for preferential treatment of native citizens over immigrants in public services and welfare.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Demands national priority in housing, education subsidies, and employment in regions like Andalusia and Valencia.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Proposes prioritizing Swedish-produced meat and capping veterinary costs for farmers, reflecting national preference policies.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Advocates for flexible school start policies and opposes agricultural agreements, emphasizing national control over education and food production.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Calls for halving France's EU contribution and prioritizing French citizens in social policies.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Supports strategic autonomy and national sovereignty in economic and technological policies.

themes.title: U.S.-Iran peace deal dominates global discourse
themes.blurb: The recent U.S.-Iran memorandum of understanding, signed by President Trump and Iran's President Pezeshkian, has sparked intense cross-national reactions. Far-right and right-wing parties in the U.S., Italy, France, Poland, and Spain are debating the deal's implications, with some praising it as a diplomatic victory and others criticizing it as a surrender.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump administration signed the deal, framing it as a diplomatic breakthrough to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and address Iran's nuclear program.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni cautiously welcomed the deal but urged Israel to support peace efforts, reflecting Italy's strategic interests in the region.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Criticized the deal's lack of transparency and potential risks to European security, aligning with broader far-right skepticism.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Expressed concerns about the deal's impact on regional stability and Poland's security interests.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Condemned the deal as a capitulation to Iran, echoing broader far-right rhetoric about national sovereignty and security.

themes.title: Internal divisions within far-right parties
themes.blurb: Far-right parties in Italy, Argentina, the UK, and Hungary are grappling with internal divisions, leadership challenges, and factional disputes. These tensions are evident in Italy's Lega and Fratelli d'Italia, Argentina's La Libertad Avanza, the UK's Reform UK, and Hungary's Fidesz and Tisza Party.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Faces internal dissent over leadership and alliances, with Salvini's Lega struggling to maintain cohesion amid rising competition from Vannacci's Futuro Nazionale.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Internal strife over corruption allegations against key figures like Manuel Adorni, threatening party unity and governance.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Nigel Farage faces backlash over controversial statements and leadership decisions, leading to resignations and public criticism.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Fidesz struggles with generational renewal and corruption scandals, while Tisza Party faces challenges in consolidating power post-election.

themes.title: Javier Milei’s declining approval amid internal strife
themes.blurb: Argentinian President Javier Milei's approval ratings are declining amid internal strife within his La Libertad Avanza party. The scandal involving his Chief of Staff, Manuel Adorni, has intensified scrutiny of Milei's leadership and governance, with cross-national reactions from the U.S., Italy, and Spain highlighting concerns over his administration's stability.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Milei's government faces internal divisions and corruption allegations, particularly involving Manuel Adorni's undeclared assets.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump's administration and allies monitor Milei's challenges, reflecting broader right-wing interest in his libertarian policies.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Italian far-right parties observe Milei's struggles, drawing parallels to their own governance challenges.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Criticizes Milei's handling of internal scandals, using it to highlight broader concerns about populist governance.

themes.title: Far-right reactions to Middle East conflicts
themes.blurb: Far-right parties in the U.S., France, Italy, Poland, and Spain are reacting to ongoing Middle East conflicts, particularly the U.S.-Iran deal and Israel's role in regional stability. These reactions often emphasize national sovereignty, security concerns, and skepticism toward international agreements.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump's administration signed the U.S.-Iran deal, framing it as a diplomatic victory while warning of potential military escalation.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Criticized the U.S.-Iran deal, emphasizing France's security interests and skepticism toward international agreements.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni urged Israel to support peace efforts while cautiously welcoming the U.S.-Iran deal, reflecting Italy's strategic interests.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Expressed concerns about the U.S.-Iran deal's impact on regional stability and Poland's security interests.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Condemned the U.S.-Iran deal as a capitulation, aligning with broader far-right rhetoric about national sovereignty and security.
